qa_database.a: Ayush combines strong algorithmic problem solving (400+ LeetCode problems, 360-day daily streak) with practical research in computer vision and LLM post-training.
His featured project is the Virtual Hand-Gesture Calculator built with Python, OpenCV, and MediaPipe, alongside LLM fine-tuning experiments.
His core technical strengths include C++, Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, competitive programming, and LLM fine-tuning.
He can occasionally over-engineer technical solutions for edge cases, which he manages by setting strict sprint deadlines.

qa_database.q: What platforms has he worked on?
qa_database.a: He has completed AI task workflows and platform guidelines on platforms like Outlier and Multimango.
